en: Monochrome postcard showing a historic wooden interior, likely from the early modern period: paneled walls with classical-style pilasters and an arched decorative niche, a latticed internal window, heavy ceiling beams, and small-paned windows with roundels. A long wooden bench runs along the wall and a large round wooden table is in the foreground. A doorway on the left leads to another similarly old-fashioned room. No printed title or caption is visible on the image side.
